verdict.rationale: The evidence documents that Transaction Data Services return account transaction data, plus separate 'insights' into transaction types, recurring transactions and consumer spending. Nothing documents per-transaction enrichment with cleaned merchant names, categories or logos. Those insights are an adjacent analytics feature, not the enrichment capability the story asks for, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, raw bank transactions come back enriched — cleaned merchant names, categories, and logos — documented as a capability of the platform, not left as an exercise for me
